description.value: Moon Wok is a family-owned Chinese restaurant group with three Kamloops locations (North Shore, South Shore, and Valleyview), all fully licensed. The restaurant is well-known locally for fresh ingredients, no added MSG, and a broad menu including vegetarian and gluten-free options. Cyclists can order take-out, dine in, or arrange catering for group events.
